exact_responses.question: DL-045 covers exactly 285 event families; none of this branch’s 53 Browser families are in that list. Should its one-family-per-landing rule also apply to these 53 Browser families?
exact_responses.answer: Apply it to the Browser families too

exact_responses.question: May the Browser and Storage owners define missing technical consumer/projector/checkpoint bindings for the exact 53 prepared Browser event families? I recommend yes, but only for already specified behavior, after a documented per-family search for existing definitions. This would not approve new features, retention/deletion choices, runtime enablement or bulk admission; each family would still need full checks, root review and its own landing.

prior_conversational_confirmation.scope: Recommendation to prepare contracts together but admit each Browser family separately after its own review/checks.

interpretation: Separate bounded authority for the exact Browser53; does not modify DL-045's original285 membership.
